jobs.description:
About HSI

HSI is a leading provider of EHS, compliance, and workforce development solutions. Through our Donesafe platform, we help organisations simplify safety, streamline processes, and strengthen workplace cultures.
As our EMEA presence grows, we're looking for a technically minded, customer-focused Implementation Consultant to join our expanding team.
About the Role

This is a hands-on implementation role where you'll own the full customer onboarding journey, from initial kick-off through configuration, testing, and go-live. You'll be the single point of contact for your clients, managing every stage of delivery to ensure successful adoption of HSI's Donesafe solution.
You won't be handing tasks to a delivery team. You'll be the principle technical resource, delivering the implementation, while building strong client relationships, and ensuring every project runs on time and to scope
We're seeking an experienced Implementation professional who combines industry knowledge with technical proficiency and exceptional client engagement skills.
The ideal candidate brings:
Exceptional communication and presentation skills
Strong analytical and technical capabilities
Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences
A proactive, solution-oriented mindset to anticipate challenges
Adaptability and meticulous attention to detail
Great listening skills. Requirement gathering is a key part of the role so the ability to ask the right questions and correctly understand the information received is essential 

What You'll Do

Lead client onboarding sessions, guiding customers through the implementation journey and setting clear expectations.
Run discovery workshops to gather and define customer requirements within the agreed scope.
Own end-to-end delivery, managing your project plan in Rocketlane and keeping work on time, in scope, and within budget.
Build, configure and document solutions in the HSI Donesafe platform, translating technical requirements into effective workflows and automations. 
Support data migration from legacy systems and ensure smooth integration.
Deliver client training and create clear user documentation for administrators and end users.
Test and validate configurations internally and with clients to meet quality and functional requirements.
Lead go-live activities and coordinate a seamless handover to Support.
Manage risks proactively, communicating and resolving issues early to keep projects on track.
Close projects confidently, finalising deliverables and supporting the transition to Customer Success.
Continuously improve by identifying opportunities to enhance implementation quality and customer experience.
Collaborate occasionally with Product or APAC teams on technical discussions or complex projects, with 2 to 5 hours per week of flexibility.

Requirements

3+ years of experience delivering end-to-end software implementations within a SaaS environment.
Background or familiarity with the EHS or Health and Safety industry is highly desirable.
Proven experience configuring workflows, forms, and automations within software platforms or similar configuration-based systems.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to lead workshops and explain technical details clearly to non-technical audiences.
Proven ability to manage multiple implementation projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining quality.
A customer-first mindset, focused on creating a positive experience and measurable value for every client.
Proactive and solution-oriented, with the judgement to make sound decisions and resolve challenges early.
Adaptable and detail-focused, with the ability to work comfortably in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Collaborative when needed, with the ability to partner with Product or global teams while working independently day to day.
Degree in IT, Business, EHS, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

Benefits

Bupa (UK) and Layla (Ireland) Private Health Insurance & Rewards
Hybrid and flexible working
Enhanced family leave benefits
Tuition assistance and professional development funding
Your birthday off every year
25+ days annual leave, increasing with service
Mental health and wellbeing support through Wisdom EAP
A collaborative culture with regular team events

jobs.description:
About

Propeller is on a mission to take the guesswork out of moving dirt - reducing wasted fuel, time, and money. We do this through the power of maps.

Our customers use Propeller's integrated hardware and software products to capture accurate 3D versions of their worksites. With over 50,000 worksites worldwide using Propeller's smart survey technology, we empower project teams to map, measure, and manage site activity.

Propeller empowers everyone to approach, own, and solve problems creatively. We're data nerds who care about impact, honesty, and each other. We take pride in being a great place to work. We are proud to be recipients of BI Group's Excellence in Customer Experience award and Inspiring Workplaces of Australasia, being recognized as a Fast Company and BuiltIn Best Place to Work. You can learn more about us on Glassdoor.

Your Mission

Empower our customers to maximize the value from our product, turning successful adoption into lasting partnerships. The Customer Success Manager
will be the primary driver of this success, directly impacting revenue retention by proactively ensuring customer health and satisfaction, and fostering account growth through identifying and realizing upsell and expansion opportunities. Ultimately, you will be key to transforming customer relationships into a powerful engine for mutual growth and sustainable business success.

Your Responsibilities

Customer Lifecycle & Adoption:

Serve as the primary relationship owner, guiding customers through adoption, expansion, and renewal
Drive engagement by ensuring customers effectively leverage Propeller's platform and tools (platform workflows, 3D mapping, GIS integrations, site/stockpile measurements, progress reporting, mobile app use cases, DirtMate adoption)
Proactively educate customers on new features, under-utilized tools, and product updates to increase adoption and impact
Manage and own product roadmap reviews with customers to align on goals, showcase value, and identify opportunities for continued partnership
Act as a trusted advisor by maintaining strong industry and product knowledge, helping customers translate data into meaningful business outcomes

Retention & Value Delivery:

Maintain strong customer relationships that ensure high adoption, satisfaction, and measurable ROI
Proactively identify risks and mitigate churn and contraction through data-driven insights and engagement
Track customer health (logins, uploads, feature usage) to ensure customers are on track with their license entitlements
Ensure customers achieve their stated goals and business outcomes, adjusting engagement strategies as needed
Maintain 90%+ Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) across your portfolio

Commercial Growth & Account Management:

Own net expansions, comprised of renewals, expansions, and upsells, in addition to churn and contraction mitigation
Identify, develop, and close commercial opportunities within existing accounts in partnership with channel partners and dealers, where applicable
Negotiate renewals and contract terms, demonstrating clear ROI and value
Educate customers on pricing changes, new product offerings, and value-added solutions
Build and maintain strategic relationships with decision-makers, aligning Propeller solutions to evolving customer needs

Collaboration & Reporting:

Track and manage customer activities, risks, and opportunities using Gainsight
Lead business reviews with customers to demonstrate value, ROI, and strategic alignment
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Support to represent customer needs, provide feedback, and help improve the product experience
Support team-wide goals, process improvements, and documentation to scale customer success and commercial impact

Requirements

Your Skills

Commercial Acumen: the ability to build compelling, ROI-driven business cases and align technology solutions with customer goals in a B2B SaaS environment
Strategic Account Growth: the ability to act as a trusted thought partner, helping customers maximize value from Propeller while identifying opportunities for expansion
Customer Relationship Management: skilled in managing a portfolio of customers — driving adoption, preventing churn, and delivering measurable business outcomes
Technologically Adept: technically curious and comfortable learning and applying new tools or platforms (experience with GIS, mapping, or data technology a plus)
Excellent Communication Skills: strong relationship-building, negotiation, and presentation skills
Data-driven: proactive, using insights to identify risks, opportunities, and areas for customer growth

Not required but bonus points if you have:

Experience in GIS, mapping, construction technology, or drone surveying
Knowledge of UAVs, GPS surveying, photogrammetry, machine control, or visualization platforms
Experience with CRM tools such as Gainsight and/or Hubspot

We operate on a hybrid model (two days a week in the office), but we ask for four days in-office during your onboarding period to give you the best possible training and support.

Propeller is for everyone, so come as you are. We value all types of experience, skill, and ability. If you don't think you meet all the requirements, but still think this role would be a good fit, we'd love to hear from you.

Diversity makes our team more creative, fun, and effective, so bring your whole self to the application process, and we will too! If you're interested in what life at Propeller is like, check out our employee-owned Medium blog page!

Benefits

Employee share options
Professional development budget and leave
The opportunity to take part in our mentorship program
Mental health resources
Monthly telephone and/or internet allowance
Paid primary & secondary parental leave policies
Hybrid work arrangements and WFH equipment provided

The salary range offered for this role is $70,000-$80,000 (base) + $15,000 - $25,000 (variable), which equals $85,000 - $105,000 (OTE). This range is tied to the market for this job in Colorado. Any salary offer extended will be based on skills, knowledge and experience.

Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

EverPro,
a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to focus on our MarketSharp product line within Customer Experience Solutions. MarketSharp helps home improvement and remodeling businesses manage leads, streamline sales and marketing workflows, strengthen customer relationships, and drive measurable growth through a purpose-built CRM platform.

The ideal candidate will serve as a day-to-day partner and trusted advisor to customers, with a primary focus on driving retention, strengthening customer relationships, and helping clients achieve continued value from the organization’s products and services. The Customer Success Manager will proactively monitor customer health, identify retention risks, and address customer needs, challenges, and opportunities before they impact satisfaction or renewal outcomes. This individual will collect and respond to customer feedback, provide focused support and best-practice guidance, and help increase product adoption, engagement, and long-term value.

Partner with Sales, Support, Product, and Implementation teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

Support retention goals by increasing customer loyalty, reducing churn, and demonstrating measurable business impact.

jobs.description:
Description

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.
Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.
At Realtor.com we are building products that empower millions of homebuyers, renters, and real estate professionals to navigate the journey of home ownership with confidence. As data sits at the heart of everything we do, protecting it is a strategic priority. In support of our journey to modernize for scale and innovation, we are seeking a SOX Compliance Analyst to lead our Sarbanes-Oxley compliance program across all Snowflake environments. This role sits within the Data Governance function and is critical to ensuring that our data infrastructure meets the highest standards of security, integrity, and regulatory accountability.
As our SOX Compliance Analyst, you will serve as the centralized point of contact for all SOX-related technical audit evidence, working closely with the Finance audit function, Data Governance, and engineering teams. You will own the end-to-end implementation of SOX controls within Snowflake, from identity and access management to change management, disaster recovery, and continuous monitoring, ensuring we achieve and maintain compliance across all Snowflake table sets.
Top reasons to apply:

Build a Cloud-Compliance Strategy from Scratch: You will have the unique career runway to architect and implement an enterprise-wide SOX compliance framework inside Snowflake from the ground up, moving the company past fragmented processes into a mature, modern data governance model.
Drive High-Impact Visibility as a Cross-Functional Enabler: This is not a siloed, checkbox compliance role. You will act as the central technical hub independently networking across Finance, Data Governance, Data Council, and Engineering teams to shield Realtor.com from audit risks while keeping product analytics fast and agile.

What you’ll do:

Lead the implementation and ongoing management of SOX compliance across all Snowflake instances, serving as the organization’s subject matter expert for data-layer SOX controls.
Maintain and enforce Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) within Snowflake, ensuring all data access adheres to the principle of least privilege.
Conduct and manage periodic user access reviews as part of the broader identity and access governance program.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Heim are powering the left shift, and forging the way for decentralisation of healthcare. Our team of technologists, clinicians, and operators design and deploy technology that unlocks frontline productivity - giving teams back the time to care.

We understand decentralised healthcare deeply. Our nurses deliver thousands of visits across the UK, whilst our technology supports over 20,000+ hours of NHS community operations. We build our technology from learnings from every patient encounter.

The Role

We are hiring a strategic Enterprise Customer Success Manager
to serve as the senior accountable lead for our most complex NHS system accounts in the UK. You will lead the full lifecycle of each NHS contract from pilot design through implementation, adoption, expansion, and renewal.

You will run large-scale deployments of Heim software inside the NHS and social care. These are the deployments the product learns from and long-term partnerships are built on. In your first two, your work will shape the working day of more than 800 nurses delivering close to a million patient contacts a year. We need someone there to get the technology in the hands of nurses quickly, grow the account, and prove the technology works and has real impact.

You are accountable for three outcomes:

Full contract value, at pace. Every contracted site, team and user live and using Heim, as fast as the partner can take it.
Growth in the contract and the product. You find where the partner can use more of Heim and where Heim should build next, and you act on both.
Evidence that holds up. Real-world evidence of the time given back to clinical care, strong enough to justify commissioning and renewal.

What You’ll Do

Realise full contract value at pace

Own each partner from contract mobilisation and governance kick-off through structured discovery, go-live and embedded business-as-usual use, with full contracted value as your headline target.
Run phased, multi-team rollouts to a plan built for speed. Track time to go-live and time to full adoption by cohort, and act when a cohort slips.
Own the DPIA support, data flow sign-off and information governance steps that gate NHS go-live, working with our Clinical Safety Officer and the Trust's governance leads.
Spot risks and blockers early, whether operational, clinical, technical or political, and have the mitigation ready before they reach the timeline or the relationship.
Be the face of Heim to the partner, trusted by both the ward and the board. Build relationships from frontline staff and super-users to the COO, Divisional Director and project sponsor, and run the weekly check-ins and monthly leadership reviews.
Coach teams through new ways of working, watch the usage data, and step in early where engagement dips or a team gets stuck.

Grow the contract and the product

Identify and execute expansion across sites, services and community teams. You own account growth with the commercial team and contribute directly to ACV, retention and NRR.
Arm champions inside the Trust to make the internal case for wider rollout, translating impact for the people who control budget, sequencing and expansion.
Work with the commercial team before signature. Scope NHS deployments, shape pilots, and design evaluation frameworks that turn into multi-year commissioning cases.
Treat every deployment as live co-design. Bring structured, prioritised feedback to Product and Engineering, and spot where Heim should build next, for example by extending Grace into further non-clinical touchpoints.
Manage expectations with care where capability is still being built or is pending regulatory approval such as MDR, keeping partners confident and well informed without over-promising.

Generate the evidence

Agree baselines with every partner at the start of a deployment, so that impact can be measured from day one.
Generate real-world evidence from deployment data on time given back to clinical care, admin reduced, drive time and mileage, working with our clinical and data colleagues to a standard that commissioners and clinical leaders will accept.
Turn that evidence into commissioning cases and renewal narratives, adjusted in depth and style for clinical, operational, IT and finance audiences. Don’t just present the insight, help them understand the story and what it means for them.
Own the return on investment story for each partner. Where the evidence is weak, you find out first and fix it.

Build the function, with AI at the core

Create the playbooks, deployment frameworks, governance packs, onboarding materials and health frameworks that make NHS implementation repeatable. This is what gets us to six live Trusts in the next 9 to 12 months.
Use AI in your own deployments, from reporting and insight to training materials and adoption tracking, and show the team how.
Set the standard as the function grows, and mentor the implementation hires who follow you.

What We’re Looking For

You grow accounts, prove value with data, and move quickly. You have done this in healthcare or a similarly complex or regulatory setting and you are from a start-up or scale-up background. We value pace of learning, so if you have grown fast and can show it, we want to hear from you whatever your years of experience.

Commercially sharp. You have grown enterprise accounts through expansion and renewal, and you can quote the numbers: ACV growth, retention, NRR. You can hold a commercial conversation on your own.
Evidence-led. You have built the case for adoption or commissioning from baselines, usage data and outcome data, and it stood up to scrutiny from finance and clinical leaders. You know what sits behind the numbers.
A deployment leader. You have led complex, multi-site implementation or transformation work, ideally delivering software into the NHS, and you know what gets clinical teams to adopt something new.
Fluent in the NHS and social care. You understand how decisions are made, who holds influence, and clinical safety and information governance in practice (DCB0129, DTAC, DPIA, MDR).
Executive in presence. You are comfortable being the least senior person in the room and still shaping the outcome. You have changed a senior stakeholder's mind, and you read complex organisations quickly without getting captured by one faction.
A builder. You can create process, structure and documentation from scratch while running a live, high-stakes programme.
AI fluent. You use AI tools daily, you keep pace with how fast they are moving, and you have ideas for how to apply them to deployments, reporting and adoption.
Calm and meticulous. The product is evolving, partners are co-designing it with us, and priorities shift. You bring order to that, with an exceptional eye for detail.

Above all, you care about this. The shift of healthcare into the home is happening, and the difference between a pilot and a partnership is usually the person leading it.

What do we believe in?

Heim builds for the future of healthcare. We believe in progress built through drive, dedication and ownership.

01 Take care:
Of our service, each other and, above all, our patients.

02 Challenge the status quo:
Healthcare has stayed unchanged for too long.

03 Build things you’d use:
Anything else isn’t good enough.

04 Be the teammate you’d want to have:
Show up, follow through and make the people around you better.

05 Win together:
We move fast, but never alone

Practical Requirements

Right to work: You must have the right to work in the UK. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.
Driving Licence: A full UK driving licence is preferred. This role spends real time on partner sites, often in services that cover a wide geography.
Availability: We are looking for an immediate start ideally, in September or October. Please tell us your availability in your application.

Why You Should Join Heim 🚀

Solve real problems in healthcare: Help healthcare overcome the limitations of legacy technology.
Give time back to the frontline: Be part of a mission that gives community teams a third of their time back. You will help reduce the 40% of the day that field staff currently spend on administrative tasks and manual workarounds.
Deeply empathetic engineering: Build tools grounded in frontline reality - our technology has been shaped by shadowing over 20,000 hours of community staff time.
Address the issues that matter most: Work on software that directly targets the top concerns of frontline staff, including lone working safety, tiresome admin and repetitive tasks.
Drive measurable impact: Deliver optimization solutions that model a 42% average reduction in drive time and up to a 52% reduction in mileage for community teams.
Build cutting-edge, secure technology: Develop AI that automates non-clinical touchpoints while working within a highly secure, ISO27001 UKAS accredited and DCB0129 compliant framework.

What We Offer

Compensation: Salary of £55,000 to £70,000 depending on experience plus a bonus/commission structure, with eligibility for equity options at the end of your probation period.
Time off: 33 days' holiday (25 days plus 8 bank holidays), plus an extra day off for your birthday (or the nearest weekday).
Direct ownership: Take direct ownership of the most important deployments in the company, working closely with our founders and the team building the product.
Culture & connection: Enjoy regular socials, team trips, meals, and an annual company retreat.
Flexibility that works: Hybrid working from our Shoreditch office, with regular travel to NHS partner sites.

How To Apply

This role is urgent, so we are moving quickly. Please include your availability to start.

Application: Send us your profile, tell us why you are a great fit for this role, and confirm when you could start.
Screening: CV screening video call.
Case study: In-person presentation, so we can see how you think, communicate, and interact.
Culture fit: In-person conversation with a founder and members of the team.

Full contract value, at pace. Every contracted site, team and user live and using Heim, as fast as the partner can take it.
Growth in the contract and the product. You find where the partner can use more of Heim and where Heim should build next, and you act on both.
Evidence that holds up. Real-world evidence of the time given back to clinical care, strong enough to justify commissioning and renewal.

Realise full contract value at pace

Own each partner from contract mobilisation and governance kick-off through structured discovery, go-live and embedded business-as-usual use, with full contracted value as your headline target.
Run phased, multi-team rollouts to a plan built for speed. Track time to go-live and time to full adoption by cohort, and act when a cohort slips.
Own the DPIA support, data flow sign-off and information governance steps that gate NHS go-live, working with our Clinical Safety Officer and the Trust's governance leads.

Use AI in your own deployments, from reporting and insight to training materials and adoption tracking, and show the team how.
